title: Free Night Awards Training Q&A: Elite Nights This Year and the Walked-Night Protected Price
content:
**What is the rule?**
For one of the Free Night Awards coming back from a reservation the hotel relocated, the elite-night reduction is the upper walked night reduction when this year's elite night credits are at least the upper walked night threshold, the lower walked night reduction when they are at least the lower walked night threshold, and nothing otherwise. It is taken off the walked-night protected price once.

| This year's elite night credits | Elite-night reduction |
|---|---|
| 75 or more (upper walked night threshold) | 2500 points (upper walked night reduction) |
| 50 to 74 (lower walked night threshold) | 1000 points (lower walked night reduction) |
| 49 or fewer | None |

**Which count is used?**
The elite night credits accrued in the current calendar year, as shown on the member's Ashbury Rewards membership record.

**Is a member with exactly 50 credits within the lower band?**
Yes. At least 50 credits take 1000 points; 74 credits also take 1000 points, and 75 credits take 2500 points.
